title: "Bertom & McCartney Lakes"
subtitle: "Following an evidence trail across a project's history"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    mathjax: null
    toc: false
params:
  report: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,warning=TRUE,error=FALSE)
r <- params$report
esc <- function(x) { y <- as.character(x); y[is.na(x)] <- ''; as.character(htmltools::htmlEscape(y)) }
table_html <- function(x,empty='No records are connected along this path in the snapshot.') {
  if(is.null(x)) return('<p class="muted">This optional source snapshot is not available in this database.</p>')
  if(!nrow(x)) return(paste0('<p class="muted">',esc(empty),'</p>'))
  paste0('<div class="table-wrap">',paste(knitr::kable(x,format='html',escape=TRUE),collapse='\n'),'</div>')
}
panel <- function(title,x,empty='No records are connected along this path in the snapshot.') cat('<details><summary>',esc(title),'</summary>',table_html(x,empty),'</details>')
```

<p class="eyebrow">Science &amp; restoration integration · model review</p>
<p class="lead">How do a research question, a historical project and a later survey connect—and what can the surviving evidence actually tell us?</p>
<div class="banner"><strong>Read this as a design prototype.</strong> This report assembles a bounded DuckDB snapshot at render time. It does not search all program holdings or query live EMMA. A connected path is not, by itself, evidence of a restoration effect or project success.</div>
<nav class="navline" aria-label="Report sections"><a href="#starting-point">Starting point</a><a href="#project">Project and intent</a><a href="#survey">Study and survey</a><a href="#findings">Findings</a><a href="#features">Restoration features</a><a href="#records">Explore records</a></nav>

## Your starting point {#starting-point}

```{r start, results='asis'}
cat('<div class="focus"><span class="pill">Starting from ',esc(r$start_type),'</span>')
if('description' %in% names(r$start)) cat('<p>',esc(r$start$description[1]),'</p>')
if(r$start_type=='project') cat('<p>UMRR-DB project reference <strong>',esc(r$start$project_id[1]),'</strong> · ',esc(r$start$namespace[1]),'.</p>')
cat('</div>')
```

The same underlying case can be viewed from a question, survey or project. The selected route determines which recorded relationships are followed; a different start may expose a different subset of the evidence.

<div class="path"><div><span>01 · QUESTION</span>A research question and any recorded relevance</div><div><span>02 · PROJECT</span>Historical intent and a candidate project connection</div><div><span>03 · SURVEY</span>A documented study event and reported findings</div><div><span>04 · FEATURES</span>GIS records linked by project number</div></div>

## Project and historical intent {#project}

The project association has its own status and scope. For question and survey starts, the UMRR-DB record is reached through the candidate study–project link; a project start follows its reference directly. An exported project status or completion date is not an ecological assessment.

```{r project-summary, results='asis'}
if(is.null(r$project_snapshot)) {
  cat('<p class="muted">The optional UMRR-DB Projects snapshot is not present in this database.</p>')
} else if(!nrow(r$project_snapshot)) {
  cat('<p class="muted">No matching project was found for this path in the imported snapshot; this does not establish absence elsewhere.</p>')
} else {
  cat('<div class="grid">')
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(r$project_snapshot))) {p<-r$project_snapshot[i,];cat('<div class="card"><span class="eyebrow">UMRR-DB · project ',esc(p$project_id),'</span><strong>',esc(p$project_name),'</strong><p>',esc(p$district),' · ',esc(p$pool),'</p><p>Exported phase: ',esc(p$phase),'<br>Exported status: ',esc(p$status),'</p><p class="meta">Geometry: ',esc(p$geometry_status),'</p></div>')}
  cat('</div>')
}
if(nrow(r$objectives)) {
  cat('<h3>Historical objectives along this path</h3><div class="grid">')
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(r$objectives))) {o<-r$objectives[i,];cat('<div class="card"><span class="eyebrow">',esc(o$objective_status),'</span><strong>',esc(o$objective_text),'</strong><p>Project association: ',esc(o$objective_relation_status),'.</p><p class="meta">',esc(o$objective_scope),'</p></div>')}
  cat('</div>')
} else cat('<p class="muted">No objective is linked along this path in the prototype.</p>')
panel('Inspect project links and their status',r$projects)
panel('Inspect the UMRR-DB snapshot and provenance',r$project_snapshot)
panel('Inspect objective associations and source locators',r$objectives)
```

Historical objectives and their candidate project associations do not establish that those objectives were entered into EMMA or that a historical target was attained. A UMRR-DB project identifier is not automatically an EMMA project identity.

## Study and survey {#survey}

For a survey start, the report follows only its linked study version. Question and project starts follow all associated versions in this fixture. A study-level association does not by itself attribute every finding to a particular event.

```{r survey, results='asis'}
if(nrow(r$studies)) {cat('<div class="grid">');for(i in seq_len(nrow(r$studies))) {s<-r$studies[i,];cat('<div class="card"><span class="eyebrow">Study version ',esc(s$study_version_id),'</span><strong>',esc(s$title),'</strong><p>',esc(s$description),'</p></div>')};cat('</div>')}
if(nrow(r$events)) {cat('<div class="grid">');for(i in seq_len(nrow(r$events))) {e<-r$events[i,];cat('<div class="card"><span class="eyebrow">Documented event</span><strong>',esc(e$description),'</strong><p>',esc(e$start_date),' to ',esc(e$end_date),'</p><p class="meta">',esc(e$source_title),' · ',esc(e$source_locator),'</p></div>')};cat('</div>')} else cat('<p class="muted">No survey event is linked to the selected study versions.</p>')
panel('Inspect study records',r$studies)
panel('Inspect survey sources and dates',r$events)
```

A historical survey can be useful even if a corresponding EMMA monitoring task is not recorded. No task or individual measurement is created to complete the path.

## Reported findings and their limits {#findings}

```{r findings, results='asis'}
if(nrow(r$findings)) {cat('<div class="grid">');for(i in seq_len(nrow(r$findings))) {f<-r$findings[i,];cat('<div class="card"><span class="eyebrow">',esc(f$authorship_status),'</span><strong>',esc(f$finding_text),'</strong><p class="meta">',esc(f$source_title),' · ',esc(f$source_locator),'</p></div>')};cat('</div>')} else cat('<p class="muted">No findings are linked to the selected study versions.</p>')
if(r$include_hypothetical) cat('<div class="banner"><strong>Hypothetical examples are enabled.</strong> They are not practitioner-authored assessments or decisions.</div>')
panel('Inspect finding records and source fingerprints',r$findings)
panel('Inspect assessments and their status',r$assessments,'No assessment is shown. Hypothetical examples are excluded by default.')
```

Findings are linked at the study-version level. A reported survey result does not by itself establish target attainment, a causal effect or project success. An absent assessment in this snapshot does not prove that no judgment was ever made.

## Candidate restoration features {#features}

Feature records below share the project number of the candidate UMRR-DB reference. This is a **candidate project-level match**. It does not establish which segment a survey sampled, spatial exposure, feature identity or ecological effect.

```{r features, results='asis'}
if(is.null(r$features)) cat('<p class="muted">The optional Restoration Features snapshot is not present in this database.</p>') else if(!nrow(r$features)) cat('<p class="muted">No matching features were found along this path in the snapshot; this does not establish absence elsewhere.</p>') else {
  cat('<div class="card"><span class="eyebrow">Source records along this path</span><strong>',nrow(r$features),' candidate feature record',if(nrow(r$features)==1) '' else 's','</strong>')
  if(r$feature_source=='geopackage') cat('<p>From the imported GeoPackage Revetment layer; geometry presence is recorded without a spatial comparison.</p>')
  if(r$feature_source=='legacy_xml') cat('<p>From the legacy XML attribute fixture; geometry was not imported.</p>')
  cat('</div>')
}
panel('Inspect feature attributes, geometry status and source hash',r$features)
```

## Explore the connected records {#records}

The question–study link may express later proposed relevance rather than the original purpose of a study. A hypothesis reached through a question is not thereby established as that study's hypothesis.

```{r details, results='asis'}
panel('Research questions and relationship status',r$questions)
panel('Hypotheses reached through questions',r$hypotheses)
cat('<details><summary>How to read the model behind this report</summary><p>The report follows separately recorded question–study, study–project and project–objective associations. It retrieves project and feature records using explicitly scoped source identifiers. Each association has its own meaning and status; traversal does not turn a candidate into a verified scientific link.</p></details>')
```

The [Bertom source review](https://github.com/MVR-GIS/restorationmonitoring/blob/main/dev/goals/bertom-rock-habitat-linkage-review.md) provides source context and unresolved questions. The [Research &amp; Design guide](../RESEARCH-DESIGN-GUIDE.html) links the other starting views and earlier prototypes.
